$comment: Conformance cases for `capability.describe` (`GET /api/v1/capabilities/{name}`), added by protocol 1.2 with issue #43. Validated against fenixspoon.core.discovery.CapabilityDescription. The shape under test is the section mechanism: every section is optional, `name` never is, and an unrequested section is absent rather than null. See environment.json for why the JS SDK does not read these.

valid.name: metrics only
valid.$comment: The acceptance criterion of #43, as a payload: sections: ["metrics"] answers with metrics and the name, and nothing whatsoever else.

valid.name: just the name
valid.$comment: Degenerate but legal: `sections: []` asks for nothing, and getting an identifiable empty answer beats an error. A caller probing whether a capability exists can use it.

valid.name: params as a reference
valid.$comment: The default: a flat parameter list plus a resolvable reference, with no JSON Schema inline.

params.name: resolution
params.description: Grid points along the longer domain edge

valid.name: params with the schema inline
valid.$comment: What `inline_schemas` returns. `json_schema` rather than `schema`, because `schema` shadows a pydantic attribute.

valid.name: every section
valid.$comment: What omitting `sections` returns, including the identity fields that are otherwise sections of their own.

payload.name: dolfinx.heat2d
payload.title: Heat sink (FEniCSx, region-tagged mesh)
payload.description: Steady conduction through the solid regions of a regions2d geometry.

geometries.note: Geometry schemas are protocol-level, not per-capability.

artifacts.name: solution.vtk
artifacts.description: The full field as a legacy-VTK file.

examples.title: coarse mesh
examples.description: A setup check, not a result.

valid.name: an artifact written unconditionally
valid.$comment: `when` is null when no parameter gates the file.

invalid.name: no name
invalid.reason: A description must say what it describes. Every other field is a section and may be absent; this one identifies the answer.

invalid.name: a metric with an unknown reduction
invalid.reason: `reduction` is a closed set — max, min, mean, integral — because #46 has to implement each one. 'median' would be a metric nothing can compute.

invalid.name: a metric with no unit
invalid.reason: A scalar without a unit is not an engineering answer. Dimensionless is spelled "1", which is a unit; omitting the field is not.

invalid.name: a params section with no schema reference
invalid.reason: The flat parameter list is a summary, not the contract. Without the reference a caller that needs the real schema has no way to ask for it.

invalid.name: metrics as an object keyed by name
invalid.reason: An ordered list, not a map: the declaration order is the order an adapter author wrote them in, which is the order a caller should read them in.
